note: Doscredobank's (Simbank) tariffs and limits for individuals of 15 September 2026, in force from 1 October 2026, and its Simbank credit card page: a Visa card in som, free to issue and to hold, on a credit limit with up to 62 days free of interest when the debt is repaid in full by the end of the month after it arose, and 26.88% a year after that. The obligatory monthly payment is 5% of the debt with a floor of 300 som, and never less than the past month's interest and penalties (the game reads the 5%). Withdrawing the credit as cash costs 3% at any ATM in the country (written; abroad, 3% with a floor of 250 som, not written), and the bank may add 1.5% on a transaction abroad or in another currency (written). A missed minimum payment draws a daily penalty at 26.88% a year on the overdue debt, capped at 10% of the limit, which isn't one of the game's terms and isn't written; nor is the installment plan's rate.
